Objective:
 1  This course is designed to impart fundamental knowledge and concepts about various
     quality management principles and systems utilized in the manufacturing industry. It also
     aids in understanding the quality evaluation in the pharmaceutical industry.


Course Outcomes: After completion of this course, student will be able to:
 1  The importance of quality
 2  ISO management systems
 3  Tools for quality improvement
 4  Analysis of issues in quality
 5  Quality evaluation of Pharmaceuticals
